$comment: Sample rclnodejs/web config consumed by `npx rclnodejs-web web.json` from a project that has rclnodejs installed. From this demo folder in a source checkout, run `node ../../../bin/rclnodejs-web.js web.json`. This local demo enables SSE/CORS explicitly; its settings are not a list of CLI defaults.

http.$comment: HTTP transport for `call`, `publish`, and action goals with SSE feedback/results. `sse` also exposes topic subscriptions; `cors: "*"` allows cross-origin browser requests for this local demo. `host` binds to loopback only (the default without it, `::`, binds all interfaces).
